speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (MSA-C) with predominant cerebellar/autonomic involvement. The progression of autonomic failure (incontinence) preceding cerebellar signs (gait ataxia, speech dysarthria) in a 54-year-old male is classic for this neurodegenerative disorder. The normal CK and metabolic panels further support a primary neurodegenerative etiology over metabolic or compressive causes.
